text.tspan: Database > conversations > {guestUid:hostUid} > messages > {messageId} | Full document fields
Unread = max(0, received - read) for each recipient.
A send transaction writes the message and counters together.
guestUid / hostUid / senderUid are string links to users.
roomId / bookingId are context links, not subcollections.
messages is inside one conversation document, never directly inside the conversations collection. Full logical references: R25-R34 in the companion dictionary.
One ordered renter-Host pair has one conversation. Admin does not automatically have permission to read private messages.
